name: readable-docs
description: Review documents for readability and consistency: terms defined before use, no forward references, no gaps the reader has to fill in.

interface.longDescription: Review a document or a set of documents so that it reads as a coherent story: a structure proposal, role-based reviewer scores, concrete replacement wording and growth areas. The skill reports; it does not edit the document.
defaultPrompt: Review this document for readability before I share it.
Check whether this spec reads in order without guessing.
